entities.summary: The Giuseppe Garibaldi-class cruisers were a class of ten armoured cruisers built in Italy in the 1890s and the first decade of the 20th century. The ships were built for both the Royal Italian Navy and for export. The class was named for Italian unifier and nationalist Giuseppe Garibaldi.
